subject: build-classes
q: Every imported profile is v5. The template is v7.
detail: v7 introduced the Core × Fill build split, the Mass/Motion archetype split, Personal Vibe pillars, the Correction Dynamic field, and the Body Synergy triad of Default, Devotion-Locked and Stamina Shape. The Archive has inferred Core and Fill from the v5 hybrid strings and left the rest empty rather than inventing them.
